name: Public Site + Member App
locked_product_rules: The public homepage must always let a visitor experience Takings - Costs = actual earnings without registration.
Every page has one primary purpose.
The member area must feel separate and premium, not like a rearranged homepage.
Free remains genuinely useful; Business and MTD are shown through restrained locked upgrade cards.
Free, Business and MTD use one continuous DriverTakings financial record.
Sophistication belongs behind DriverTakings. Simplicity belongs in front of the driver.
Member takings entry uses Total Takings, Card and On Account; Cash is calculated automatically.
Member core dashboard always shows estimated tax provision, Class 4 NI provision and Yours to spend — estimated.
Paid entitlement changes the member tier label and removes the Business upgrade card for Business/MTD members.
Future changes repair or extend the fixed member-dashboard baseline rather than simplifying/recreating it.

stripe.entitlement_sync: Successful Checkout is server-verified and synced to Supabase; Stripe webhook lifecycle sync remains required for cancellation/renewal state.
